:::{#def-block-code}
#### Block code

Let $\codealph$ be a finite alphabet with $q \ge 2$ symbols,
and let $k \le n$ be positive integers.
A **block code** with message length $k$ and block length $n$
is a one-to-one map $E : \codealph^k \to \codealph^n$.
Its image $C = \set{E(m) : m \in \codealph^k}$ is the set of *codewords*,
and its **rate** is $R \eqdef k/n$,
the number of message symbols carried per symbol sent.

:::
